segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Karen. I wanted to confirm the scope before I send the order form over. I have you at 42 technician seats, 6 manager seats, and the calibration scheduling module included for the Ohio and Indiana sites. Is that still right?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right. We may add two more technicians in Q3, but for the initial rollout it's 48 total seats.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Okay, perfect. The pricing sheet has that at $3,840 per month on an annual term, billed quarterly. Implementation is a one-time $7,500, and that includes the data import from your current spreadsheets and two admin training sessions.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Quarterly billing is fine. On the implementation, can you make sure the invoice separates software and services? Our accounting team needs those as separate line items.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, no problem. I'll note that for billing. For timing, if we get signature by May 17, we can start kickoff the week of May 27 and target go-live for July 8. Does that work with your audit calendar?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, our internal audit starts July 22, so July 8 gives us a little buffer. I just need the asset list loaded by the end of June.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. We'll need the final asset export by June 14 to hit that. I'll include that as a customer milestone in the implementation plan.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. What about the contract language on renewals? I want to avoid auto-renewing for more than one year.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Standard term is one year auto-renewal with 60 days' notice, same length as the initial term. Since this is a 12-month agreement, it would renew for 12 months unless you cancel or we amend it.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that's acceptable. Send the order form and the implementation outline today, and I'll route it through purchasing.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I'll send it within the hour, and I'll copy your purchasing alias. If they need a W-9 or vendor packet completed, just forward it to me.
